link_notes: The paper is about a differential-state analysis method; the simulator is only one component (used to evaluate methods), and the README covers analysis tools, not a data generator.

open_release.rationale: Nothing in the sources frames simulated data as releasable or privacy-preserving.

pipeline_testing.rationale: The simulation is used to evaluate statistical methods, not to exercise software or formats.

ml_augmentation.rationale: No train-on-synthetic or augmentation use appears.

statistical_replication.rationale: The simulation is built to mimic real multi-sample scRNA-seq data, anchored to a reference dataset.

quotes.text: To evaluate method performance, we developed a flexible simulation that mimics multi-sample scRNA-seq data.

causal_inference.rationale: No causal or DAG framing; the simulation specifies differential-state effects only.

education.rationale: The sources show no teaching or tutorial use of the simulation.

benchmarking.rationale: The simulation framework exists to compare differential-state analysis methods.

quotes.text: A simulation framework is developed to evaluate various methods to perform cross-condition differential state analyses
